'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Forage|forageable]] item that can be obtained by foraging in the Boneyard area of [[Crimson Badlands]]. There is also a 2% chance of Swirl Stone being produced by [[Void Eel]] when at maximum population in a Fish Pond. Despite being foraged off the ground, {{PAGENAME}} is classified as [[Stardew:Monster Loot|Monster Loot]].
